title: Reading the folded tape
statement: Let $t\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\operatorname{Option}(\Gamma)$ be a tape content and let $z\in\mathbb{Z}$. Reading the folded tape at the folded position $\varphi(z)$ on the side determined by whether $z\ge 0$ returns exactly $t(z)$.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ assigns an optional symbol in $\Gamma$ to each integer cell
replaced:
For every tape content $t \colon \bbz \to \Gamma \cup \{\square\}$ over a base
alphabet $\Gamma$ and every integer $z$, reading the folded tape of $t$ at the
physical position $\varphi(z)$ on the side of $z$ returns exactly the original
content $t(z)$, where $\varphi(z) = z$ for $z \ge 0$ and $\varphi(z) = -z-1$
otherwise.
